pack.name: spritesheet-fixtures
pack.summary: Texture atlas descriptors — libgdx .atlas dialect, with page and region metadata.

license.covers: libgdx and its bundled test assets.

cocos2d-x declares MIT in its README (no LICENSE file at the root). NOTE: licenses/LICENSE_artwork.txt covers the bundled artwork separately and NON-UNIFORMLY — six different licences across it: grossini*.png is CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 (redistributable, so -full and -demo eligible), several tile sets are GNU GPL v2, one is Common Public License, one carries a custom Lost Garden licence, Fonts/*.ttf say 'For personal Use', and tuffy_bold_italic-charmap.png is public domain. Critically, Images/spritesheet* carries 'LICENSE: unsure... don't use them in your project' — upstream declining to vouch for the very assets a spritesheet pack would want. This pack takes only text descriptors, so none of that reaches it; recorded because the descriptors reference those images by name and anyone rendering rather than parsing must read that file first.
